AllocatedRegistered(address,uint256).details: Emitted when an Allocated is registered

AllocatedRemoved(address).details: Emitted when an Allocated is removed

Approved(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when an admin approves the zeroed address.

ContractDeployed(uint8,uint256,uint256).details: Emitted when the contract is deployed `rebalanceBlockNumber` is the target block number of the execution the rebalance in Core `deployedBlockNumber` is the current block number when its deployed

Finalized(string,uint8).details: Emitted when the contract is finalized memo - is the result of the treasury fund rebalancing

StatusChanged(uint8).details: Emitted when the contract status changes

ZeroedRegistered(address).details: Emitted when a Zeroed is registered

ZeroedRemoved(address).details: Emitted when a Zeroed is removed

params._allocatedAddress: is the address of the allocated

approve(address).details: zeroedAddress can be a EOA or a contract address. To approve:      If the zeroedAddress is a EOA, the msg.sender should be the EOA address      If the zeroedAddress is a Contract, the msg.sender should be one of the contract `admin`.      It uses the getState() function in the zeroedAddress contract to get the admin details.

params._zeroedAddress: is the address of the zeroed

checkZeroedsApproved().details: verify if quorom reached for the zeroed approvals

params._rebalanceBlockNumber: is the target block number of the execution the rebalance in Core

finalizeApproval().details: finalizeApproval sets the status to Approved,      After this stage, approvals will be restricted.

finalizeContract().details: sets the status of the contract to Finalize. Once finalized the storage data of the contract cannot be modified. Also it sets the memo with pendingMemo value. It will be used for public disclosure. Can only be called by the current owner at Approved state after the execution of rebalance in the core

finalizeRegistration().details: finalizeRegistration sets the status to Registered,      After this stage, registrations will be restricted.

getAllocated(address).details: to get allocated details by allocatedAddress

params._allocatedAddress: is the address of the allocated

returns._0: allocated is the address of the allocated
returns._1: amount is the fund allocated to the allocated

getAllocatedCount().details: gets the length of allocateds list

getAllocatedIndex(address).details: get index of the allocated in the allocateds array

params._allocatedAddress: is the address of the allocated

getTreasuryAmount().details: to calculate the sum of allocated funds

returns.treasuryAmount: the sum of funds allocated to allocateds

getZeroed(address).details: to get zeroed details by zeroedAddress

params._zeroedAddress: is the address of the zeroed

getZeroedCount().details: gets the length of zeroeds list

getZeroedIndex(address).details: get index of the zeroed in the zeroeds array

params._zeroedAddress: is the address of the zeroed

isContractAddr(address).details: Helper function to check the address is contract addr or EOA

isOwner().details: Returns true if the caller is the current owner.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

registerAllocated(address,uint256).details: registers allocated address and its fund distribution

params._allocatedAddress: is the address of the allocated
params._amount: is the fund to be allocated to the allocated

params._zeroedAddress: is the address of the zeroed If the zeroed address is a contract, make sure its adminList is not too long because otherwise the for-loops around adminList or approvers may run out of gas. However, processing even 1000 admins is feasible as it takes a few million gas. The number of multisig admins is much less than 1000 is not in normal use cases and the zeroed contracts are trusted by the Owner, so out of gas is unlikely.

removeAllocated(address).details: remove the allocated details from the array

params._allocatedAddress: is the address of the allocated

removeZeroed(address).details: remove the zeroed details from the array

params._zeroedAddress: is the address of the zeroed

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. > Note: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

reset().details: resets all storage values to empty objects except targetBlockNumber

setPendingMemo(string).details: sets the pendingMemo of the Contract. Once finalized, the memo cannot be modified.

params._memo: is the result of the rebalance after executing successfully in the core.  - memo format: { "before": { "zeroed": { "0xZeroedAddress1": [balance of zeroedAddress1 before rebalance],                  "0xZeroedAddress2": [balance of zeroedAddress2 before rebalance], ...},                  "allocated": {  "0xAllocatedAddress1": [balance of AllocatedAddress1 before rebalance],                  "0xAllocatedAddress2": [balance of AllocatedAddress1 before rebalance], ...}},                  "after": { zeroed": {  "0xZeroedAddress1": [balance of zeroedAddress1 after rebalance],                  "0xZeroedAddress2": [balance of zeroedAddress2 after rebalance], ...},                  "allocated": { "0xAllocatedAddress1": [balance of AllocatedAddress1 after rebalance],                  "0xAllocatedAddress2": [balance of AllocatedAddress1 after rebalance], ...}                 }, "burnt": [burnt amount], "success": [true/false] }

sumOfZeroedBalance().details: to calculate the sum of zeroeds balances

returns.zeroedsBalance: the sum of balances of zeroeds

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params._rebalanceBlockNumber: is the target block number to be updated

params._zeroedAddress: is the address of the zeroed

devdoc.title: Smart contract to record the rebalance of treasury funds. This contract is to mainly record the addresses which holds the treasury funds before and after rebalancing. It facilates approval and redistributing to new addresses. Core will execute the re-distribution by reading this contract.
